text:
This solution, Republic of Korea Landslide Information System (LIS) addresses natural catastrophe in South Korea between Korea Forest Service (KFS), Korea Institute of Geoscience and Mineral Resources (KIGAM), National Institute of Forest Science (NIFoS), International Consortium on Landslides (ICL), and International Programme on Landslides (IPL). The program was implemented in 2015, 
2023 and focuses on collaboration and leveraging tech.
